verdict.rationale: Anytype is clearly local-first and offline. Content is stored locally on the device in a Vault you own, the app is documented to always work without internet, and a local-only mode disables the backup node entirely. However, the store is an encrypted, app-specific container, so reading notes without the app depends on exporting to Markdown or Any-Block. Missing for 10: notes stored as plain files readable without the app, and independent hands-on corroboration of full offline operation.
